sources.notes: Official KMZ 'Safari Rally Kenya KMZ' (zip containing doc.kml, posted on safarirally.ke/competitors 2026-02-19, internal timestamps 2026-01-30) with Documents per day, Waypoints (XX-TC, XX-Start, XX-FF, XX-Stop) and Tracks (stage LineStrings named '<Stage> 2026', plus liaison tracks). Start/finish here are the Road Book 1 V.2 (4 Mar 2026) GPS list, converted from S/E degrees+decimal minutes; KMZ Start/FF waypoints agree within ~0-30 m except Sleeping Warrior FF. Stage lines START->FF along-line vs V1.4 km: Camp Moran 24.40/24.35, Mzabibu 8.87/8.86, Loldia 25.52/18.95 (outdated, see SS4/9), Geothermal 13.11/13.16, Kedong 13.89/13.79, Soysambu 25.20/24.94 (=SR V1 25.20), Elmenteita 18.10/18.01, Sleeping Warrior 18.49/18.41 (=SR V1), Oserengoni 18.53/18.22, Hell's Gate 10.61/10.48 - i.e. the KMZ reflects the earlier (V1-era) routes; small end changes possible. Shakedown (not in stages list): RB start S0°42.969' E36°26.946' (-0.71615,36.4491), FF S0°43.528' E36°27.253' (-0.725467,36.454217); KMZ line 'Shakedown NAWISA 2026' 6.30 km. Matching by stage name in RB list and KMZ track names is unambiguous.
